title: Linux systemd readiness and watchdog follow authenticated GitHub observer successes
summary: Strengthens the uninstalled P00 read-only observer service with opt-in Type=notify readiness and watchdog pulses only after authenticated remote success and durable owner-fenced SQLite evidence. Does not deploy a persistent agent.
migration_notes: No deployed service or end-user migration. Existing read-only Linux service template changes to Type=notify and must be reviewed/installed only by an authorized operator; it is not yet installed. Observer SQLite schema remains unchanged.
